note: AI-authored source-specific maintenance evidence questions; not generated catalog findings or operational instructions.

questions.question: What time/population scope can the released CSV support?
questions.about: MetroPT-3 source-scoped APU; physical identity unverified

data_requests.item: Release/export provenance and usable observation windows
data_requests.fields: Original acquisition cadence, export/transformation history, unnamed-field meaning, timezone and documented missing intervals; reconcile the description with the released file.
data_requests.how: Ask the dataset or historian custodian for the versioned export recipe and original timebase. Retain the file profile as observations, without inferring downsampling or treating unreported periods as healthy.
where: Versioned acquisition/export records held by the data custodian

locations.description: Versioned acquisition/export records held by the data custodian

questions.decision_rule: Separate published acquisition claims from released-file observations. Do not impose a uniform period, invent a timezone or silently interpolate gaps.
questions.limits: Development packet. No human owner, approval, plant truth or effectiveness claim; suggested custodians are evidence locations, not assignments.

questions.question: How are the two printed #1 failure records kept separate?
questions.about: MetroPT-3 source-scoped APU; physical identity unverified

data_requests.item: Stable external event and asset identities
data_requests.fields: Original failure/work-record IDs and revisions, affected train/APU identifier, event dates and links to this dataset release.
data_requests.how: Ask the failure-record custodian for the original records. Use document hash and table-row locator until a verified external identity is supplied; a printed number alone is insufficient.
where: Original failure reports or maintenance system, with its record custodian

locations.description: Original failure reports or maintenance system, with its record custodian

questions.decision_rule: Keep table rows 1 and 2 separate while preserving their identical printed number. Internal row ordinals are locators, not corrected report numbers.
questions.limits: Development packet. No human owner, approval, plant truth or effectiveness claim; suggested custodians are evidence locations, not assignments.

questions.question: What intervention, if any, belongs to the May 29-30 reported interval?
questions.about: MetroPT-3 source-scoped APU; physical identity unverified

data_requests.item: Original execution record and date clarification
data_requests.fields: Work-record ID/revision, affected APU, work performed, actual start/completion, year/timezone, resulting configuration and return-to-service disposition; clarify the literal 30Apr note.
data_requests.how: Request the original work record and date clarification from its custodian. Preserve both the May interval and April note until reviewed evidence explains their relationship.
where: Maintenance execution record and operational return-to-service record

locations.description: Maintenance execution record and operational return-to-service record

questions.decision_rule: Do not change April to May, equate a reported interval ending with repair completion, or infer which work was executed.
questions.limits: Development packet. No human owner, approval, plant truth or effectiveness claim; suggested custodians are evidence locations, not assignments.

questions.question: Is there enough evidence to review the June/July maintenance effectiveness?
questions.about: MetroPT-3 source-scoped APU; physical identity unverified

data_requests.item: Intervention identity, comparable outcomes and attributed effectiveness review
data_requests.fields: Verified work-record revision, affected asset and action/configuration; before/after operating conditions and exposure window; usable measurement coverage, chosen metric, uncertainty and dated reviewer disposition.
data_requests.how: First reconcile the original execution record with operations. Then prepare comparable observations under a defined criterion for an authorized reviewer. A copied completed status or maintenance note alone leaves insufficient evidence.
where: Maintenance, operations and measurement custodians in the existing execution system

locations.description: Maintenance, operations and measurement custodians in the existing execution system

questions.decision_rule: Retain insufficient evidence until the intervention and comparable observations are linked and reviewed. Do not infer successful repair, root cause, downtime or causal improvement from the table.
questions.limits: Development packet. No human owner, approval, plant truth or effectiveness claim; suggested custodians are evidence locations, not assignments.

data_requests.fields: Exact export column names and dictionary revision, engineering units and any transformation; explicitly check Oil_temperature and Motor_current against their names rather than the PDF enumeration.
data_requests.how: Compare the original header and source dictionary, then obtain the export owner's mapping verification before joining channels to plant identities. Keep the exact DV_eletric spelling.
where: CSV header, source dictionary and controlled channel-mapping record

locations.description: CSV header, source dictionary and controlled channel-mapping record

questions.decision_rule: Do not pair values by the PDF item order. Keep source definitions, literal column names and recorded values distinct.

questions.question: Does the first recorded electrical state identify a unique operating mode?
questions.about: MetroPT-3 source-scoped APU; physical identity unverified

data_requests.fields: Applicable control/configuration revision, timestamp/timezone mapping, state transitions and operational observations distinguishing off from offloaded conditions.
data_requests.how: Ask the controls/operational counterpart to reconcile the state timing and applicable configuration. Retain raw flags and motor-current values without assigning a unique operating mode.
where: Applicable controls export and operational state/event records

locations.description: Applicable controls export and operational state/event records

questions.decision_rule: A source-described COMP/DV flag combination permits more than one condition. A near-zero current is an observation, not a verified unique mode or failure diagnosis.
questions.limits: Development packet. No human owner, approval, plant truth or effectiveness claim; suggested custodians are evidence locations, not assignments.
